label: ZC3H7B::BCOR

sections.text: ZC3H7B encodes a zinc-finger-containing protein with proposed RNA-associated regulatory functions.
BCOR encodes a transcriptional corepressor associated with noncanonical Polycomb repression.

The fusion joins ZC3H7B to the transcriptional corepressor BCOR and defines a BCOR-rearranged stromal sarcoma group. These tumors often show high-grade spindle cells in myxoid stroma and can mimic myxoid leiomyosarcoma.
